title: Trace: what the engine recorded on every physics tick of one replay (never shown to the fixer)
description: Written by the Godot harness (harness/godot/expectrail_harness.gd) and the Unity harness (harness/unity/package). World coordinates are pixels with y pointing down. Readers ignore fields they do not know, so a field added here must stay optional. Not listed in expectrail.contracts.KINDS (that file is frozen by discovery/freeze.json); validate with expectrail.contracts.validate(doc, 'trace').

unknownActions.description: Distinct route action names missing from the game input map. An empty list means all were present. An absent field means the harness did not report this information.

roleBoxes.description: Configured Godot recorder: every row carries roleObjects, including an empty list when no bound instances exist on that tick. Bindings never found anywhere refuse the replay, not a successful empty trace.

objectBoxes.description: Added Nov 15, 2026 by the Godot harness (#286): true when every row carries enemyBoxes and projectileBoxes. Absent on a trace from before; a reader then has no box for an enemy or a projectile and never guesses one.

groundSources.description: Added Nov 13, 2026 by the Godot harness: where a row's ground may come from. tiles: the level has tile layers; bodies: how many of its bodies count as platforms (StaticBody2D, AnimatableBody2D and CharacterBody2D other than the player, enemies and projectiles).

viewport.description: Configured Godot output width and height in captured-frame pixels.

bindings.description: The project role bindings the harness resolved; role names are the keys.

levelSurfaces.description: Every solid surface of the level as a polygon of [x, y] world points.

levelArt.description: Where the level's floor is drawn: per world column from x0, the [top, bottom] runs that are drawn.

playerVisible.description: The bound Godot player node is visible in its tree at this tick. Engine lifecycle state only, not pixel visibility or evidence that the sprite is drawn. Absent means unknown, never true.

ground.description: World y of the level surface under the player, from the level's geometry (tiles, and since Nov 13, 2026 the authored collision of its platforms), never from the player's own collider.

groundFrom.description: Added Nov 13, 2026 by the Godot harness, with ground: whether the surface is a tile's or a platform body's.

body.description: Added Nov 12, 2026 by the Godot harness: the world box [left, top, right, bottom] of the player's own collision in this tick (its collision shapes and polygons that are not disabled, as they stand in the world: scaled, mirrored). How big the engine says the player is, and where. Left out when the player has no collision to measure; a reader never guesses one.

uiIntegers.description: Engine state only: integer-only text on visible Label nodes in the current scene. Empty means none; null means the bounded collection overflowed. Absent on older traces. Not proof of pixels, clipping or occlusion.

enemyBoxes.description: Added Nov 15, 2026 by the Godot harness (#286): [id, left, top, right, bottom], the world box of the own collision of each enemy in enemies (same id) that has one to measure, measured as body is for the player. An enemy with nothing to measure is left out.

projectileBoxes.description: Added Nov 15, 2026 by the Godot harness (#286): the same as enemyBoxes, for each projectile in projectiles.

view.description: [xx, xy, yx, yy, ox, oy]: a world point (x, y) lands at (xx*x + yx*y + ox, xy*x + yy*y + oy) in frame pixels. It is the camera of the frame drawn before this row's tick; readers take the next row's view for this tick's frame (agents/observations.py, _view_at).

roleObjects.description: Configured Godot instances, re-resolved each tick. Dynamically spawned instances appear on their first recorded tick. Removed instances disappear; a hidden instance keeps its geometry and visible=false. box uses the following tick camera, as view readers do (the last row keeps its own view).

objects.description: Added Nov 9 for the Unity harness (the Godot harness does not write it): every tracked object as the engine placed it in this row's own frame (the frame of this tick, not the view convention above).

id.description: The object's hierarchy path; a later object on a path already used gets #2, #3 ... in the order the recorder first saw them.

box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in frame pixels, y down, from the renderer's bounds; null when the object has no renderer.

visible.description: Active, its renderer enabled, a sprite to draw, alpha above 0 and its bounds inside the camera's frustum.

id.description: Scene-relative path with literal # doubled; replacement instances on that path get #2, #3, etc. Shared across roles bound to the same instance.

worldBox.description: AABB in world pixels, y down, of the measured geometry after all node transforms.

box.description: AABB in captured-frame pixels, y down, before clipping. Transforms actual geometry vertices, not just the world AABB.

visible.description: Engine lifecycle state: at least one measured drawing is visible in its tree, or the root is visible for a collision-only object. Does not prove pixels were drawn, alpha, occlusion, shaders, or being on screen.

boundsSource.description: Drawing: visible Sprite2D current rects, AnimatedSprite2D current frame rects or Polygon2D vertices; all measured drawing bounds are retained when the whole instance is hidden. Collision fallback: enabled shapes/polygons when there is no supported drawing. Excludes other bound roots and nested physics bodies.
